note: These three files are a FORK, copied byte for byte from dnilgis/bids. They are not a re-implementation. Every rule in them was written against a real incident on this board or another on the same platform, and re-deriving them by hand is how the nuance gets lost. The fork is the point: this repo must keep reading Boyceville when dnilgis/bids is down, being rewritten, or gone.
cost: A fork does not receive later fixes. test/fork.test.mjs records what was copied so a future session can diff against dnilgis/bids and decide, rather than wonder.
